## Assessment (data verification verdict)

- VERDICT: XAUUSD tape ACCEPTED for the SP2L XAUUSD native re-test.
- Stitch quality: 0 monotonic violations, 0 duplicate timestamps, 0 spread
  inversions, 0 non-positive quotes across 385,483,125 ticks. The
  2024-12-31 hole between the vendor files (dukascopy-node exclusive
  'to' date) was patched with a dedicated same-source fetch
  (xauusd-tick-2024-12-31-2025-01-01.csv, 170,903 ticks); the patch bridges
  file2's last tick (2024-12-30 23:59:59.549) and file3's first tick
  (2025-01-01 23:00:00.455) with no overlap and no gap.
- All 389 gaps >= 3h map to weekends, US holidays, or early closes; the
  only unexplained gaps are exactly three 3.0h blocks (2022-04-13,
  2022-05-10, 2025-12-02), consistent with vendor maintenance and
  negligible over 6.7 years.
- The top consecutive-tick mid changes ($48-$110) all occur at the first
  tick after daily/weekly opens (22:00/23:00 UTC); in-window tick-to-tick
  moves are <= ~$11 on a $4,300-$5,400 metal. No bad prints found.
- Point convention (Q2): 3 decimals throughout (point = 0.001); SP2L
  thresholds bound in DOLLARS per the confirmed resolution ($1.00 gap,
  $10.00 max SL), NOT as literal 0.001-point multiples.
- Cost floor (Q4): full-tape median spread $0.41; cash [09:30,16:00) NY
  median $0.399; overnight median $0.419; p99 <= $1.63. The US500 0.51 pt
  floor is NOT reused.
- Session structure: daily tape 20:00 -> 19:59 NY (approx. 24h with a
  17:00-18:00 NY break), stable across 2020-2026.
- Bar exports verified: M1 2,337,538 bars; M5 467,633 bars; M1->M5
  agreement IDENTICAL (0 mismatches, equal bucket counts).
- Known edge truncations (declared): tape ends 2026-09-01 20:59:59.911 UTC
  (the vendor fetch stopped at the 21:00 UTC daily close; the 22:00 UTC
  reopen onward is absent). Tape starts 2020-01-01 23:00 UTC (vendor
  range start). Both ends are data-window facts, not data loss.
